src: lower-left color source tile and lower-right stencil tile
dst: output rectangle sized by foreground counts in the upper-left and upper-right control quadrants
transform: tile the lower-right stencil; replace each stencil background pixel with the corresponding coarse lower-left color, or tile the lower-left region directly when the stencil is empty
grid_shape: height = count(upper-left foreground), width = count(upper-right foreground)
